node.title: Re^3: Authorizing with NTLM - Problem Domain
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: I don't know anything about [mod://Authen::NTLM], and the docs aren't really helpful here, but the thread linked to in the AM post shows the method being used as $ua->credentials('10.1.1.1:80', '', 'myDomain\\user', 'password');. What is your $Options->{'user'}, have you tried my $Options = { user => 'Domain\\UsernameIsHere', ...?
